passage_section: Pulmonary cavitation; fibrosis; immune-mediated lung injury
claim_supported: Candidate: active pulmonary TB can cause inflammatory lung tissue destruction, cavitation and fibrotic remodeling.

passage_section: Lung remodeling; pulmonary impairment after TB
claim_supported: Candidate: TB-related cavitation, fibrosis and bronchiectasis can contribute to lasting obstructive or restrictive respiratory impairment.

passage_section: Summary; observed patterns of TB-related lung damage
claim_supported: Candidate: residual parenchymal and airway damage after pulmonary TB can be associated with persistent respiratory symptoms and abnormal lung function.
